title: One issue payload, closed on the side that leaves the machine
description: The whole field set a report may carry. It is an allow-list and not a filter: logs, diff, source, specs, chain, environment, paths, host, user, email, IP address, remotes and client data have no field to arrive in, so no scanner has to catch them there. What a scanner catches is those classes smuggled inside the prose fields, which is the only route left.

kind.description: A security finding never becomes a public issue. The kind decides the route before anything is written, not after somebody reads the prose.

steps.description: Written by the person reporting. A step is a sentence somebody typed, never a captured command line: a captured command carries the path it ran from.

framework_version.description: This package's own version. It is the one fact populated without being typed, because it is a property of the software being reported and not of the machine reporting it.
